cues.text: The dorm rooftop. Ken faces you with his toy weapon, while Akihiko, Junpei and Koromaru stand by to watch.
Ken lunges at you and the match begins. Soon he is panting, his face pained.
Ken charges in again, and your blow catches him.
Yukari steps out onto the roof, and you turn toward her. In that moment Ken dashes in and lands a clean hit on you.
Yukari heads back downstairs, and Koromaru, Junpei and Akihiko follow her, leaving you alone on the roof with Ken.
Ken steps up to you and gives you a small silver key.
